slides.big: So I started choosing it myself.
slides.photo: REAL PHOTO: Justin at the laptop, YouTube open. No children's faces.

slides.big: I'd find videos I thought were right and line them up myself.
It took ages. It was hard to keep up. And it didn't fix the real problem.
The next video still wasn't mine to choose.
So I had it built properly.
slides.body: With developers. Explaining what was in my head until someone else could build it.
You choose the age, the subject, the tone, the time of day and how long. We build the playlist around it.

slides.big: Tomorrow: the real thing, on my phone.
slides.body: What would you want it to find first for your child?
